/ball-x-pit/.alt: Ball x Pit combat with several balls on the field and the carried loadout at left
/ball-x-pit/.purpose: A real run shows the battlefield and carried loadout that the recipe and build guides refer to.

/ball-x-pit/evolutions/.alt: Ball x Pit snowfield with the carried balls and passives at the left edge
/ball-x-pit/evolutions/.purpose: Compare the carried-loadout area with your recipe ingredients. This combat image does not demonstrate the Evolution menu.

/ball-x-pit/passive-evolutions/.alt: Ball x Pit carried balls above a separate row of passive icons
/ball-x-pit/passive-evolutions/.purpose: The left-side rows distinguish carried balls from passive items. The written core-selection steps below come from the cited report, not this combat image.

/ball-x-pit/builds/.alt: Ball x Pit battlefield with lightning effects and a multi-ball loadout
/ball-x-pit/builds/.purpose: The loadout and active effects show why a build involves more than choosing one named evolution; no DPS or clear-rate claim is inferred.

/ball-x-pit/character-tier-list/.alt: Armoured Ball x Pit hero aiming balls through a desert battlefield
/ball-x-pit/character-tier-list/.purpose: A manual aiming situation provides context for choosing by control style; the screenshot is not a comparative character benchmark.

/ball-x-pit/beginners-guide/.alt: Ball x Pit desert run showing aimed trajectories and enemies ahead
/ball-x-pit/beginners-guide/.purpose: Use the visible aim lines and open space to understand the first-run movement and aiming discussion.

/ball-x-pit/ghostly-shield/.alt: Ball x Pit run with carried passive icons displayed separately from the battlefield
/ball-x-pit/ghostly-shield/.purpose: Locate your carried passive row before checking the stone-ally prerequisite. This frame is not a Ghostly Shield offer or proof that the prerequisite was met.

/ball-x-pit/new-evolutions/.alt: Ball x Pit ice-stage combat with the carried loadout displayed at left
/ball-x-pit/new-evolutions/.purpose: Check the exact names in your loadout before following an added recipe. This undated store frame does not establish which free-update recipes are unlocked.

/ball-x-pit/characters/.alt: New Ballbylon settlement with multiple constructed buildings
/ball-x-pit/characters/.purpose: The settlement is the place where house construction matters; this overview does not guarantee any particular blueprint drop.

/ball-x-pit/trophy-guide/.alt: Ball x Pit town with farms and building plots
/ball-x-pit/trophy-guide/.purpose: The town view illustrates the between-run construction work in the trophy route; it is not a completed trophy record.
